packageRules.description: Group Python (backend) minor and patch updates into a single PR
Python (backend) major updates get their own PR
GitHub Actions updates, including with: version inputs (e.g. astral-sh/setup-uv, aquasecurity/trivy-action)
Docker image and ARG-templated digest updates (backend/Dockerfile)
The Python base image tag (major/minor/patch) is bumped manually per docs/conventions.md (Runtime Version, Version Bump Checklist) — only the digest is refreshed automatically here
Keep the uv version used by astral-sh/setup-uv (CI) and the uv binary copied into the Docker image (COPY --from) in sync — see backend/Dockerfile comment
